Hi Helen — thanks for the clear note and the ticket. We can perform a full purge and supply a signed evidence bundle. A couple quick clarifications before ops runs the job:

1) Do you want embedded vectors (if any) removed from our similarity index as well, or only raw prompt/output/log objects?
2) Confirm that the list below is in-scope:
   - s3://redwood-logs/datapulse-atlas/ (prompt & output artifacts)
   - s3://redwood-traces/datapulse-atlas/ (request traces)
   - Dedicated pool KV caches (us-west-2, pool-id: dp-west-02)

If yes to vectors, note that we will remove index entries and corresponding blobs; we cannot recover them after purge. Ops will run the sweep and produce: CSV manifest of removed object keys, an execution log, and a signed PDF certificate.

ETA: we will start within 2 business hours of your confirmation and aim to complete within 4–6 hours.

If you approve scope, reply with a brief confirmation and we will proceed.

Best,
